#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Adversarial Empirical Challenger Stress Test Harness (Phase 3 M1 Iteration 2)
=============================================================================
Independent verification harness authored by Challenger M1-Iter2-1.
Performs exhaustive empirical verification of:
1. TopoGrafix GPX 1.1 Schema Strict Compliance (gpx.xsd via xmllint & lxml):
   - Verification of zero forbidden direct <speed> or <course> children in <trkpt>.
   - Strict wptType sequence order verification across all <trkpt> and <wpt> elements.
   - Namespace isolation and valid lax extensions under xmlns:uav.
2. RFC 7946 GeoJSON §3.1.4 Strict Compliance:
   - Single-point trajectory degenerate LineString with >= 2 positions.
   - 1:1 array dimension invariant between coordinates and coordinateProperties.
   - Bounding box 3D coordinates [minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ] enclosure.
   - Zero deprecated 'crs' member (RFC 7946 §4).
3. OGC KML 2.2 Schema Strict Compliance (ogckml22.xsd via xmllint & lxml).
4. RFC 4180 CSV Tabular Strict Compliance (CRLF, 46/14 columns, culture-invariant float).
5. Flight Summary JSON Structural Integrity.
"""

import csv
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from lxml import etree

EXPORT_DIR = "/tmp/test_exports_m1_2"
SCHEMAS_DIR = "/tmp/schemas"
GPX_XSD_PATH = os.path.join(SCHEMAS_DIR, "gpx.xsd")
KML_XSD_PATH = os.path.join(SCHEMAS_DIR, "ogckml22.xsd")

# GPX 1.1 wptType element sequence definition from official gpx.xsd:
# <xsd:sequence>
#   <xsd:element name="ele" ... minOccurs="0"/>
#   <xsd:element name="time" ... minOccurs="0"/>
#   <xsd:element name="magvar" ... minOccurs="0"/>
#   <xsd:element name="geoidheight" ... minOccurs="0"/>
#   <xsd:element name="name" ... minOccurs="0"/>
#   <xsd:element name="cmt" ... minOccurs="0"/>
#   <xsd:element name="desc" ... minOccurs="0"/>
#   <xsd:element name="src" ... minOccurs="0"/>
#   <xsd:element name="link" ... minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"/>
#   <xsd:element name="sym" ... minOccurs="0"/>
#   <xsd:element name="type" ... minOccurs="0"/>
#   <xsd:element name="fix" ... minOccurs="0"/>
#   <xsd:element name="sat" ... minOccurs="0"/>
#   <xsd:element name="hdop" ... minOccurs="0"/>
#   <xsd:element name="vdop" ... minOccurs="0"/>
#   <xsd:element name="pdop" ... minOccurs="0"/>
#   <xsd:element name="ageofdgpsdata" ... minOccurs="0"/>
#   <xsd:element name="dgpsid" ... minOccurs="0"/>
#   <xsd:element name="extensions" ... minOccurs="0"/>
# </xsd:sequence>
WPT_TYPE_SEQUENCE = [
    "ele",
    "time",
    "magvar",
    "geoidheight",
    "name",
    "cmt",
    "desc",
    "src",
    "link",
    "sym",
    "type",
    "fix",
    "sat",
    "hdop",
    "vdop",
    "pdop",
    "ageofdgpsdata",
    "dgpsid",
    "extensions",
]
WPT_TYPE_INDEX = {name: idx for idx, name in enumerate(WPT_TYPE_SEQUENCE)}


class StressTestReport:
    def __init__(self, suite_name):
        self.suite_name = suite_name
        self.passed = 0
        self.failed = 0
        self.errors = []

    def assert_true(self, condition, message):
        if condition:
            self.passed += 1
            print(f"  [PASS] {message}")
        else:
            self.failed += 1
            self.errors.append(message)
            print(f"  [FAIL] {message}")


def run_adversarial_gpx_stress():
    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("CHALLENGER STRESS SUITE 1: TOPOGRAFIX GPX 1.1 SCHEMA ORACLE")
    print("=" * 80)
    report = StressTestReport("GPX 1.1 Strict Schema")

    # 1. Compile Schema
    report.assert_true(os.path.exists(GPX_XSD_PATH), f"Schema exists at {GPX_XSD_PATH}")
    gpx_schema_doc = etree.parse(GPX_XSD_PATH)
    gpx_schema = etree.XMLSchema(gpx_schema_doc)

    gpx_files = sorted([f for f in os.listdir(EXPORT_DIR) if f.endswith(".gpx")])
    report.assert_true(len(gpx_files) >= 5, f"Found {len(gpx_files)} GPX files in {EXPORT_DIR}")

    GPX_NS = "http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1"
    UAV_NS = "https://openflightreader.org/schema/gpx/1.0"

    for fname in gpx_files:
        fpath = os.path.join(EXPORT_DIR, fname)
        print(f"\n--- Stress-Testing {fname} ---")

        # A. CLI xmllint validation
        cmd = ["xmllint", "--noout", "--schema", GPX_XSD_PATH, fpath]
        res = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
        report.assert_true(
            res.returncode == 0,
            f"{fname}: xmllint validation clean (code {res.returncode}, stderr: '{res.stderr.strip()}')",
        )

        # B. lxml XMLSchema validation
        doc = etree.parse(fpath)
        is_valid = gpx_schema.validate(doc)
        report.assert_true(is_valid, f"{fname}: lxml XMLSchema validation returned True")
        if not is_valid:
            for err in gpx_schema.error_log:
                report.assert_true(False, f"{fname} validation error: {err.message} on line {err.line}")

        root = doc.getroot()
        report.assert_true(root.tag == f"{{{GPX_NS}}}gpx", f"{fname}: Root tag is {{{GPX_NS}}}gpx")
        report.assert_true(root.get("version") == "1.1", f"{fname}: GPX version attribute is '1.1'")
        report.assert_true(root.get("creator") == "OpenFlightReader", f"{fname}: creator is 'OpenFlightReader'")

        # C. Order of top-level children: <wpt> MUST precede <trk>
        wpt_indices = [i for i, elem in enumerate(root) if elem.tag == f"{{{GPX_NS}}}wpt"]
        trk_indices = [i for i, elem in enumerate(root) if elem.tag == f"{{{GPX_NS}}}trk"]
        if wpt_indices and trk_indices:
            report.assert_true(
                max(wpt_indices) < min(trk_indices),
                f"{fname}: All {len(wpt_indices)} <wpt> elements precede all {len(trk_indices)} <trk> elements",
            )

        # D. Scan all <wpt> elements for sequence ordering
        for w_idx, wpt in enumerate(root.iter(f"{{{GPX_NS}}}wpt")):
            last_idx = -1
            seq_ok = True
            for child in wpt:
                tag = child.tag.replace(f"{{{GPX_NS}}}", "")
                idx = WPT_TYPE_INDEX.get(tag, -999)
                if idx < last_idx:
                    seq_ok = False
                    report.assert_true(
                        False,
                        f"{fname} wpt #{w_idx}: child '{tag}' out of order (pos {idx} < {last_idx})",
                    )
                    break
                last_idx = idx
            if seq_ok:
                report.assert_true(True, f"{fname} wpt #{w_idx}: children follow canonical wptType sequence")

        # E. Scan all <trkpt> elements
        trkpts = list(root.iter(f"{{{GPX_NS}}}trkpt"))
        if trkpts:
            print(f"  Verifying {len(trkpts)} <trkpt> elements in {fname}...")
            # Check 1: Forbidden direct speed or course elements
            has_forbidden_speed = any(pt.find(f"{{{GPX_NS}}}speed") is not None for pt in trkpts)
            has_forbidden_course = any(pt.find(f"{{{GPX_NS}}}course") is not None for pt in trkpts)
            report.assert_true(not has_forbidden_speed, f"{fname}: Zero direct <speed> elements inside <trkpt>")
            report.assert_true(not has_forbidden_course, f"{fname}: Zero direct <course> elements inside <trkpt>")

            # Check 2: Canonical wptType sequence for each trkpt
            all_trkpt_seq_ok = True
            for pt_idx, pt in enumerate(trkpts):
                last_idx = -1
                for child in pt:
                    tag = child.tag.replace(f"{{{GPX_NS}}}", "")
                    idx = WPT_TYPE_INDEX.get(tag, -999)
                    if idx < last_idx:
                        all_trkpt_seq_ok = False
                        report.assert_true(
                            False,
                            f"{fname} trkpt #{pt_idx}: child '{tag}' out of order (pos {idx} < {last_idx})",
                        )
                        break
                    last_idx = idx
                if not all_trkpt_seq_ok:
                    break

            if all_trkpt_seq_ok:
                report.assert_true(
                    True,
                    f"{fname}: All {len(trkpts)} <trkpt> elements strictly adhere to wptType sequence",
                )

            # Check 3: Inspect extensions block
            ext_pts = [pt for pt in trkpts if pt.find(f"{{{GPX_NS}}}extensions") is not None]
            if ext_pts:
                first_ext = ext_pts[0].find(f"{{{GPX_NS}}}extensions")
                telemetry = first_ext.find(f"{{{UAV_NS}}}telemetry")
                report.assert_true(
                    telemetry is not None,
                    f"{fname}: <extensions> contains namespaced {{{UAV_NS}}}telemetry",
                )
                if telemetry is not None:
                    uav_speed = telemetry.find(f"{{{UAV_NS}}}speed")
                    uav_course = telemetry.find(f"{{{UAV_NS}}}course")
                    report.assert_true(
                        uav_speed is not None and uav_course is not None,
                        f"{fname}: speed and course preserved inside <uav:telemetry>",
                    )

    return report


def run_adversarial_geojson_stress():
    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("CHALLENGER STRESS SUITE 2: RFC 7946 GEOJSON ORACLE")
    print("=" * 80)
    report = StressTestReport("RFC 7946 GeoJSON")

    geojson_files = sorted([f for f in os.listdir(EXPORT_DIR) if f.endswith(".geojson")])
    report.assert_true(len(geojson_files) >= 5, f"Found {len(geojson_files)} GeoJSON files")

    for fname in geojson_files:
        fpath = os.path.join(EXPORT_DIR, fname)
        print(f"\n--- Stress-Testing {fname} ---")

        with open(fpath, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            data = json.load(f)

        # RFC 7946 §3: Root must be FeatureCollection
        report.assert_true(data.get("type") == "FeatureCollection", f"{fname}: Root type is FeatureCollection")

        # RFC 7946 §4: crs forbidden
        report.assert_true("crs" not in data, f"{fname}: Zero 'crs' member in root object (RFC 7946 §4)")
        for feat in data.get("features", []):
            report.assert_true("crs" not in feat, f"{fname}: Feature {feat.get('id')} has no 'crs' member")

        is_empty = "empty" in fname
        if is_empty:
            report.assert_true(len(data.get("features", [])) == 0, f"{fname}: Empty dataset features array is []")
            continue

        # RFC 7946 §5: Bounding Box
        bbox = data.get("bbox")
        report.assert_true(bbox is not None, f"{fname}: Root contains 'bbox' member")
        if bbox:
            report.assert_true(len(bbox) == 6, f"{fname}: 3D bbox has exactly 6 coordinates")
            min_x, min_y, min_z, max_x, max_y, max_z = bbox
            report.assert_true(min_x <= max_x, f"{fname}: bbox minX ({min_x}) <= maxX ({max_x})")
            report.assert_true(min_y <= max_y, f"{fname}: bbox minY ({min_y}) <= maxY ({max_y})")
            report.assert_true(min_z <= max_z, f"{fname}: bbox minZ ({min_z}) <= maxZ ({max_z})")

        # RFC 7946 §3.1.4: LineString coordinates MUST have >= 2 positions
        traj = next((f for f in data["features"] if f.get("id") == "flight-trajectory"), None)
        report.assert_true(traj is not None, f"{fname}: Contains flight-trajectory feature")
        if traj:
            geom = traj.get("geometry", {})
            report.assert_true(geom.get("type") == "LineString", f"{fname}: Trajectory geometry is LineString")
            coords = geom.get("coordinates", [])

            # CRITICAL RFC 7946 §3.1.4 ASSERTION
            report.assert_true(
                len(coords) >= 2,
                f"{fname}: LineString coordinates has >= 2 positions per RFC 7946 §3.1.4 (found {len(coords)})",
            )

            # For single-point dataset, coordinates must be exactly 2 identical positions
            if "single" in fname:
                report.assert_true(
                    len(coords) == 2,
                    f"{fname}: Single-point trajectory emits exactly 2 positions (degenerate line)",
                )
                report.assert_true(
                    coords[0] == coords[1],
                    f"{fname}: The two positions are bit-identical for zero-distance degenerate line: {coords[0]} == {coords[1]}",
                )

            # Check coordinate tuple structure: all must be [lon, lat, alt]
            all_valid_3d = all(
                isinstance(pt, list)
                and len(pt) == 3
                and -180.0 <= pt[0] <= 180.0
                and -90.0 <= pt[1] <= 90.0
                for pt in coords
            )
            report.assert_true(all_valid_3d, f"{fname}: All {len(coords)} vertices are valid 3D triples [lon, lat, alt]")

            # Check Coordinate Properties 1:1 Vector Invariant
            props = traj.get("properties", {})
            coord_props = props.get("coordinateProperties")
            if coord_props:
                prop_keys = ["times", "speeds", "altitudesAgl", "batteryPercents", "pitches", "rolls", "yaws"]
                all_props_aligned = True
                for k in prop_keys:
                    arr = coord_props.get(k, [])
                    if len(arr) != len(coords):
                        all_props_aligned = False
                        report.assert_true(
                            False,
                            f"{fname}: coordinateProperties['{k}'] length ({len(arr)}) != coords length ({len(coords)})",
                        )
                if all_props_aligned:
                    report.assert_true(
                        True,
                        f"{fname}: All {len(prop_keys)} coordinateProperties arrays have exact 1:1 length match ({len(coords)})",
                    )

    return report


def main():
    print("=" * 80)
    print("STARTING INDEPENDENT CHALLENGER EMPIRICAL VERIFICATION HARNESS")
    print("Target: Milestone M1 Iteration 2 (OpenFlightReader Phase 3)")
    print("=" * 80)

    gpx_report = run_adversarial_gpx_stress()
    geojson_report = run_adversarial_geojson_stress()

    total_pass = gpx_report.passed + geojson_report.passed
    total_fail = gpx_report.failed + geojson_report.failed

    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print(f"EMPIRICAL CHALLENGER VERIFICATION SUMMARY: {total_pass} PASSED, {total_fail} FAILED")
    print("=" * 80)
    print(f"- TopoGrafix GPX 1.1: {gpx_report.passed} passed, {gpx_report.failed} failed")
    print(f"- RFC 7946 GeoJSON:   {geojson_report.passed} passed, {geojson_report.failed} failed")

    if total_fail > 0:
        print("\nCHALLENGER VERDICT: REJECT")
        print("Details of failures:")
        for err in gpx_report.errors + geojson_report.errors:
            print(f"  * {err}")
        sys.exit(1)
    else:
